name: Production Brain Pipeline
purpose: Transform a user idea into validated production planning artifacts before media generation.
execution_rules: A stage cannot execute until every declared input artifact exists and validates.
Every output is versioned and fingerprinted.
A generated output must pass structural and semantic validation before becoming an input.
The generating model cannot approve its own output.
Failed stages may use bounded targeted repair; exhausted failures escalate to HUMAN_REVIEW.
Downstream stages cannot silently rewrite upstream truth; changes require a new artifact version.
